translations.web: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
translations.bsb: They speak mere words; with false oaths they make covenants. So judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of a field.
translations.kjv: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
translations.asv: They speak vain words, swearing falsely in making covenants: therefore judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
